name: ringtools-mobile
description: Ringtools voor iOS en Android (Capacitor 8): gebundelde, lichte React-client voor de bestaande Ringtools-backend.

scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:aab: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:ios:simulator: npm run cap:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.build:ios:simulator:personal: npm run cap:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App-PersonalTeam -configuration Debug-PersonalTeam -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.verify:ios-configs: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && ./scripts/verify-ios-configs.sh
